answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 44043 Country: India Title: Roza Question: In fast while performing wudhu, if water enters to throat through nose, will the fast be valid or we will have to make its qaza. Please guide me. Answer ID: 44043 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 888/691/D=1434) Fast shall break if water enters in the throat via nose while performing wudhu. You will have to make its qaza. It is so mentioned in Imdad al-Fatawa Vol. 2, p. 129. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
